subject: Clarifying invoice handoff for vendor pilot — compact template & next steps
messages:
From: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@acmecorp.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, accounts-payable@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 8 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding — how should we submit invoices during pilot?

Hi Sofia / Redwood AP team,

We’re ready to start the supplier onboarding pilot for Acme Corp (vendor ID 67321). Before we send our first invoices I wanted to confirm the preferred intake path and file layout so our AR team can prepare. A few quick questions: 

- Is the supplier portal required for the pilot or can we email invoices to accounts-payable@redwood.com?
- Do you accept a single PDF invoice covering multiple POs, or do you prefer one PO per invoice?
- Is there a minimal line-item schema (e.g., description, qty, unit price, PO number, tax, currency) we should follow?

We’d like to avoid rework once invoices hit your system. Happy to do a short test invoice if you provide a compact template.

Thanks,
Tom Hsu
Director, Finance Ops — Acme Corp
Tom Hsu | tom.hsu@acmecorp.com
[attachment: acme_supplier_form_v2.pdf (PDF, 95 KB)]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — how should we submit invoices during pilot?

Hi Tom — great to hear you’re ready. Short answer: portal-first, email-backstop during pilot. Details below and a compact CSV template attached.

Portal vs Email
- Primary intake: Redwood Supplier Portal (preferred) — it gives automatic PO matching and faster payment.
- Email fallback: accounts-payable@redwood.com is acceptable for the pilot only; invoices submitted by email will be routed to manual processing which may add 2–4 business days to processing. Please use the subject convention: "Invoice | ACME | PO: <PO_NUMBER> | INV: <INVOICE_NUMBER>".

PO rules
- Preferred: one PO per invoice for automated matching. If you must include multiple POs on a single invoice, include a clear line per PO and the invoice may require manual review.

Compact template (attached) — required fields
- invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), po_number, line_description, qty, unit_price, tax, currency, remit_name, remit_address, reference_id
- File types: CSV (preferred for bulk), single-page PDF (acceptable), or combined PDF with an index CSV for multiple POs.

Action items
1) Try the attached compact_invoice_template.csv and return a single test invoice (PDF or CSV).
2) If you want portal access, let us know the user emails and we’ll provision a vendor account (SLA: 48 hours).

I’ve CC’d Vanessa (vendor onboarding) to provision portal access and Markus (payments) for matching rules.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Vendor Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
[attachment: compact_invoice_template.csv (CSV, 2 KB)]

From: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@acmecorp.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — how should we submit invoices during pilot?

Hi Sofia — thanks, that helps. We’ll do a single test invoice by email (PDF) today using your subject convention.

Couple small clarifications:
- For the CSV template, should tax be per-line or a single invoice-level tax column? We can provide either.
- For "reference_id" — would you prefer our internal invoice ID or your vendor ID?

I’m attaching a test PDF (single PO) and a completed compact CSV for your test ingestion path. If you confirm receipt and whether the CSV maps cleanly to your parser, we’ll flip to portal-only by the second week of the pilot.

Thanks,
Tom
[attachment: acme_test_invoice_0001.pdf (PDF, 42 KB)]
[attachment: compact_invoice_template_filled.csv (CSV, 1 KB)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@acmecorp.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — how should we submit invoices during pilot?

Hi Tom — received both attachments and validated the basic ingestion. Quick notes from the validation run: 

- The PDF arrived and is visible in our AP queue. Manual entry required for PDFs; your single-PO PDF looks good.
- The filled CSV mapped but we made two small mapping tweaks: 
  * We expect tax as an invoice-level column named "tax_total"; if present per-line we’ll aggregate.
  * "reference_id" should be your invoice number (internal ID) — we’ll reconcile with vendor ID on our side.

Next steps:
1) We’ll provision portal access for user provisioning emails you send today (SLA 48 hours).
2) For the pilot, please send both: a CSV (preferred) and the PDF as backup for the first three invoices so we can validate end-to-end. After that we’ll ask you to submit via portal only.

Payment/process expectations:
- Email-submitted invoices: processing time +2–4 business days vs portal-submitted: standard SLA.
- PO matching failures will generate an automated exception and the AP analyst will reach out to your accounts team.

Thanks for sending the test files — everything looks good with the small tax/reference tweak.

Vanessa Ortiz
Vendor Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
